messages.author: 67d8bf82c1969b27
messages.subject: should I install R and rhipe on all the hadoop nodes ?
parts:
I have a cluster which have 16 servers, I want to deploy Rhipe on this cluster, should I install R and rhipe on all the nodes ? or just like Dumbo(a python tool using hadoop stream to  write mapreduce) just need install on one node of the cluster ? than you for your reply in advance !

--

messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] should I install R and rhipe on all the hadoop nodes ?
parts:
I recommend installing R on one node and shipping the distribution as a DistributedCache file.

See https://github.com/saptarshiguha/RHIPE/wiki/Using-rhipe-on-a-cluster--without--installing-R-on-the-nodes

Do others have alternate ways to do this?

Dumbo works because python is found on nearly every linux installation. R is not.

The method is i i recommend is good because not everyone has permissions on the nodes, you can have clusters with 30+ nodes and installing packages/upgrading
is a pain.

Cheers
Saptarshi
